The mathematics teacher is really good and teaches in a clear and effective manner. However, the major issue is that very little time has been allotted to cover such a vast SSC syllabus. The time given is so short that it feels more like a fast-track course rather than a regular course. In such a situation, no matter how excellent the teacher is, students may feel that they are not able to understand the concepts properly. The real problem lies in the limited time schedule, not in the teacher?s teaching quality. If adequate time is provided, students will be able to grasp the concepts much better and fully benefit from the teacher?s efforts.

Subject: Request for Batch Change Due to Genuine Reasons

Respected Sir/Madam,

I would like to bring to your notice that due to my B.E. examinations and my father?s health issues, I was absent for around 50 days. Because of this, I have fallen behind in my syllabus and am facing difficulties in coping with the current batch.

Apart from my personal issues, the present batch environment is also troubling me, which is affecting my studies and making it difficult to concentrate.

When I approached the management to request a batch change, I was only given the option of the 5:00?8:00 PM batch, which is not possible for me as it would make me return home very late. Unfortunately, despite explaining my situation, no proper action has been taken so far.

Therefore, I sincerely request you to kindly allow me to shift to the 11:15 AM batch, as this timing is suitable for me and will help me cover my pending syllabus effectively in a better environment.

I hope you will consider my genuine reasons and help me continue my studies without further problems.

Thanking you,
[Niraj kumar ]
